name: MotherDuck MCP
description: Lets agents query and explore MotherDuck and DuckDB databases over a remote OAuth MCP server, and build Dives, schedule Flights, and maintain Guides.

skills.name: SQL Queries
skills.description: Runs read-only and read-write SQL against MotherDuck databases, guided by server instructions for writing DuckDB SQL.

skills.name: Schema Exploration
skills.description: Explores databases, schemas, tables, and columns, and attaches or detaches MotherDuck shares for an agent session.

skills.name: Dive Visualizations
skills.description: Creates and manages Dives, which are interactive data visualizations, and renders them inline in supported MCP clients.

skills.name: Scheduled Flights
skills.description: Creates, schedules, runs, and monitors Flights, which are scheduled Python jobs that run on MotherDuck compute.

skills.name: Context Guides
skills.description: Reads and writes Guides holding metric definitions and join conventions so agents produce accurate SQL for an org.
